messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert — sharp rise in p95 latency on eu-prod inference-gateway. Metric spike started ~5m ago, sustained for 3m. Auto-routing degraded. Paging eng-oncall.
eng-oncall: on it, joining. grabbing initial logs.
eng-oncall: confirming: p95 ~1.9s (baseline 350ms), 500s increasing. Error rate stable but tail latency bad.
maya: I saw 502s from a few customers, correlating with kv-cache miss rates. KVs are cold on a subset of nodes.
sam: any deploys in last 30m?
ops-bot: recent deploy: model-variant swap to v2-quant at 3376542900 by alex (canary).
alex: that canary was 10% on eu, should be isolated but rolling back now.
eng-oncall: rollback command queued: `rdwctl rollout cancel --target model-variant:v2-quant --env eu-prod`
eng-oncall: also increasing inference-gateway replicas by +3 to absorb bursts: `rdwctl scale --service inference-gateway-eu --replicas +3`
priya: opening a quick cache warm job to pre-populate popular prefixes: `python infra/scripts/warm_kv.py --region eu --prefixes top50`
maya: adding sticky routing to bypass prefix cache for now: route -> non-cached pool for affected customers.
sam: creating a mitigation runbook in thread, short notes for on-call handoff.
sre-lead: set severity to S2 and status page to "degraded performance". Draft below for status page and customer DM. Please review fast.
eng-oncall: ACK — rolling to customers affected list while we stabilize.
-----
Status page draft (for immediate post):
- Summary: We are investigating elevated request latency impacting some EU inference requests.
- Impact: Higher-than-normal response times (p95 up to ~2s) for a subset of customer requests; no data loss reported.
- Mitigation: Rolling back recent canary model-variant, scaling gateway replicas, and performing cache warm-up.
- ETA: partial relief expected within 20-40 minutes; full recovery targeted within 90 minutes.
- Next update: in 15 minutes or sooner as status changes.
-----
Customer DM template (short):
Hi — we’re investigating higher-than-normal latency for requests routed to our EU inference service. We’ve initiated mitigations (rollback of a canary model variant, autoscale increases, and cache warm-up). We expect partial improvement within ~30 minutes. We’ll message you again with updates; reaching out if you want finer-grained routing options in the meantime. — Redwood Inference Ops
-----
maya: small note — two heavy tenants (tenant-a and tenant-b) show most of the spikes; I'm going to temporarily throttle bursty jobs on tenant-a where possible.
alex: rollback applied, canary aborted. Monitoring now.
ops-bot: rollback completed at 3376543330.
eng-oncall: scaling completed at 3376543360, replicas +3 up; CPU load dropped on gateway pool.
priya: cache warm-up job started at 3376543375. early KV hit-rate improved ~18% for sampled prefixes.
sam: updating incident ticket with timeline and actions. tagging SRE and Runtime teams.
sre-lead: publish status page now. Assigning follow-up: postmortem owner = maya.
eng-oncall: pushing a short customer-facing note to priority list now.
maya: throttle applied to tenant-a on burst QPS. observed immediate drop in p95 to ~620ms for non-throttled traffic.
eng-oncall: good signal. keeping throttles for 15m while cache warms.
alex: telemetry shows error-rate unchanged, tail latency improving to ~500-700ms; still above baseline but trending down.
eng-oncall: tentative ETA update: expect p95 back near baseline within 25-35 minutes barring regression.
priya: will follow up with a longer-term mitigation suggestion in retro: improve KV pre-warm during canaries and add faster fallback to CPU quantized variant for cold prefixes.
sre-lead: excellent. once stable — notify customers that mitigations applied, and we'll follow with root-cause and timeline.
eng-oncall: passing to next on-call in 20m window for monitoring handoff — @maya please take post-recovery checks; I’ll leave the thread.
maya: taking it. will post final recovery and any data needed for postmortem.
incident-bot: Next automated update scheduled in 15 minutes.
eng-oncall: thanks all, nice quick rollback and warm-up.
